දෘශ්‍ය ප්‍රලස සූර්යයා උතුරට ගමන් කිරීප්‍රම්දී සූර්යයා, අප්‍රේල් මස 05 සිට 15 දක්වා දින්‍වලදී ශ්‍රී ලංකාව ආශ්‍රිත
අක්්ාංශ්‍වලට සෘජුවම ඉහලින් පවතී. ප්‍රහට(06) දින්‍ දහවල් 12:13 ට ප්‍රේරුවල, ගුරුළුබැද්ද, රක්වාන්‍,
ප්‍රගාඩකප්‍රවල, උඩවලව සහ තණමල්විල යන්‍ ප්‍රප්‍රද්ශ්‍වලට හිරු මුදුන් වනු ඇත.
GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 05 April 2026.
Tonight:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern,
Uva, Eastern and Northcentral provinces.
Fairly heavy falls about 50 mm are likely at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces
and in Polonnaruwa and Hambantota districts.
Tomorrow:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Northern, Eastern, North-central, Central
and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in
Ampara district during the early hours of the morning.
The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused
by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
On the apparent northward relative motion of the sun, it is going to be directly over the latitudes of
Sri Lanka during 05th to 15th of April in this year. The nearest areas of Sri Lanka over which the sun is
overhead tomorrow (06th) are Beruwala, Gurulubadda, Rakwana, Godakawela, Udawalawe and
Thanamalwila at about 12:13 noon.
